channel.title: Sorana releases
channel.description: Release notes for Sorana, the free desktop AI workspace for Windows and Linux.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.92
item.description: MCP tools slash command, research answer quality (fetched sources outrank pasted text), enriched research trace, live-suite hardening, reviewer cost control, background job tracking, approval-gated memory distillation, agent output caps, graceful search degradation, and fixes for URL probing, memory bleed, sidebar orphans, telemetry leaks, approval-resume crashes, and Gmail archive progress.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.91
item.description: 13 selectable themes with picker, whole-app theme sweep, central color palette, IT/NL/PL language parity, natural wording in 7 languages, agent card upgrades, persistent Model Manager layout, resizable sidebars, enforced max reply length, background token refresh, responsive trace flow layout, and theme/markdown/memory fixes.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.90
item.description: Redesigned Agent Advanced tab, agent card upgrades, persistent Model Manager layout, supervised subagent runtime, token refresh, multi-angle coverage proof, reviewer judge-independence, grounding telemetry, and synthesis/parser fixes.
